questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will slope downward steeply ahead. Check your brakes before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. This sign tells you to get ready for traffic entering from the right side of the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. The speed number on these signs tells you the safe speed to drive through the upcoming curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe and clear to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. This sign marks a crosswalk where people cross the road. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign forbids right turns at this intersection. Turning right here is illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests or bright jackets and use paddles and flags to control traffic through construction zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mean work zone activity. Stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign tells you a flagger is coming and you must obey their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming construction or maintenance area.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped yellow signs warn you about upcoming hazards or special conditions. Orange signs indicate construction or maintenance areas ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that other vehicles may be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve right first, then left. Slow down and be ready to follow the curves safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that vehicles from the right may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and yield to pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down and be prepared to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and yield to pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Come to a complete stop at the marked line or before the intersection. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass, then proceed carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for a side road entering ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors and road maintenance vehicles display this orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully and reduce your speed in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop if one is coming. Never try to go around the gates before a train passes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Be ready for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells drivers that turning right or left on a red light is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that the road splits ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that people may be crossing the road ahead. Stay alert and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully and reduce speed in wet conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that cyclists may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is prohibited. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic flows in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is prohibited. This sign means left turns are not allowed.
